categories.name: kernel
categories.evidence: Adds C API functions and C++ wrapper headers in src/kernel/ and kernel test coverage for script execution tracing.
categories.rationale: Exposes intermediate script execution states to libbitcoinkernel consumers for debuggers and visualizers. The PR adds an optional compile-time API that downstream tools (such as rust-bitcoinkernel) can build on, but it is an opt-in debugging extension rather than core block validation or chainstate functionality, making it worthwhile but deferrable.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Touches src/script/interpreter.cpp with the Validation label, but the changes are macro hooks whose primary subject is the kernel library API, which the validation category explicitly excludes.
categories.rationale: The PR does not substantively alter consensus rules, validation invariants, or default node execution behavior. The category explicitly excludes PRs whose primary subject is the kernel library API.
